Class Tasks.Task

java.lang.Object
app.Tasks.Task
Enclosing class:
Tasks
public static class Tasks.Task extends Object
Represents one multi-step task that the player can complete.

Each task has an id, an ordered list of step descriptions, a pointer to the current step, and a completion status.
